summary: ZEO ScientifiX filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing the faculty and guest speaker lineup for its inaugural ZEO Xperience, a three-day regenerative medicine educational event for healthcare professionals scheduled October 23-25, 2026, at the Pier Sixty-Six Resort in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 and is signed by CEO/CFO Ian T. Bothwell. No transaction, securities offering, strategic action, or special-situation event is disclosed; this is an ordinary current report on a marketing/educational event with no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no risk-arb angle.
